passage:
Dear Director Martinez,

As a long-time resident of the Westview community and a frequent user of the Pine Street Dog Park, I have always appreciated our local parks as important spaces for both families and pets. However, the current lack of maintenance at this park has become a major concern, and it is no longer a safe place for people to visit.

My main concern is the complete lack of lighting in the park. For the past three weeks, five out of the seven main lights in the off-leash area have stopped working. During these winter months, when it gets dark early in the evening, the entire area becomes completely dark by 5:30 PM. This is very unsafe because owners cannot watch their dogs closely, and visitors—especially seniors—feel uncomfortable walking alone on the dark pathways.

In addition, the gate at the entrance to the small dog section is broken and dangerous. The heavy metal gate has come off its lower hinge and is currently held up by a piece of wood. Just yesterday, I saw a small child almost get hurt when the gate suddenly moved. Along with some sharp, rusted sections of the fence near the water fountain, it is clear that basic repairs are being ignored at this location.

As local residents, we pay city taxes and expect our neighborhood parks to be clean and safe for everyone. It is very disappointing to see our park in such poor condition while nearby neighborhoods get regular maintenance and modern park upgrades. We are not asking for expensive changes, but we do expect basic safety repairs to be made.

I am requesting that a repair crew be sent to the park this week to handle the following issues:

Replace all the broken light bulbs in the off-leash area.
Fix and properly attach the hinges on the main entrance gate.
Repair the broken fencing so dogs cannot run out into the busy road nearby.

I have attached a few photos showing these problem areas for your review. I look forward to hearing an update about these repairs before the end of the week.

Sincerely,
David Chen
Westview Residents Committee
